notes: Indiana publishes two public Google Calendars (conference and youth department); both were read as ICS feeds and merged (same title and start date), plus the 2026 youth calendar image and the quarterly "Conference Connection" event lists. School breaks, office closures and the cancelled October Pathfinder backpack trip are not counted. The youth department feed also contains 22 private appointments (interviews and Zoom meetings with named people, with meeting links) — these were excluded and not recorded. Some feed titles carry the wrong year (e.g., "2025 Tween Camp" dated July 2026). The conference theme for 2026 is "Threads of Grace: The Fabric of Family" (camp meeting focus on families). Mission Development and Evangelism Director post created 2026 (Lilly Endowment grant); the conference evangelism page is a contact point, not an event list.
